tested_use_case: Startup Banking — Business banking and card platforms for startups: payments, spend controls, yield, and accounting sync. Judged against the ranking's evidence-graded story taxonomy: 74 user stories across 11 themes.
limitations: India (partial): The India-facing business offering is "receive money from abroad" for freelancers and exporters — not the full multi-currency Wise Business account.

Mexico (partial): Mexico-regulated business offering (“Wise está regulado por la Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores en México”), but Mexico is absent from Wise’s hold-a-balance country list — send/pay focused, no balance holding.
Peru (partial): Peru is on Wise’s hold-a-balance country list with no business-profile restriction, but Wise publishes no Peru business page.
